protected_invariants: CodeWhale Rust is the sole implementation base and DeepSeek is the sole target model backend.
Root and child agents converge on one AgentRuntime, one event protocol, and one RunStore.
Writing agents use isolated worktrees and evidence for the latest workspace revision.
A new path names and deletes the old path it replaces; no permanent dual runtime or state truth.
Stable model/tool prefixes change only deliberately and deterministically.
Stable Rust only; no nightly-only language features.
branch_policy: Confirm the live branch and worktree before editing. Preserve unrelated changes. Use one reviewable concern per commit. Do not push, release, force-push, or repoint remotes without explicit user direction.

before_claiming_done: run the narrowest relevant deterministic tests and cargo checks
compare capability changes against docs/product/EVALUATION.md when applicable
read changed files and inspect the final diff
never claim verification that was not performed

escalate_when: a destructive action would remove unpreserved user work
a change would violate an accepted architecture invariant
external credentials, publishing, or irreversible remote state are involved
